name: 03743 · Claremont, NH
findings: ZIP 03743 (Claremont) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03743 (Claremont) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 03743 (Claremont) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
